programme.desc: 1948. Comedy. Director: John Irwin. Stars Cyril Fletcher, Betty Astell, Laurence Naismith. A magical guest, who can conjure anything one can wish for, causes trouble for a writer and his wife.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A spectacular performance of Up On The Roof in this wonderful musical video from the 60s.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Pigeon Decoy/Fishing with a Dog Nobbler. 1980. Jack Hargreaves demonstrates the use of a mechanical pigeon decoy before going trout fishing with an artificial minnow called a 'dog nobbler'.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. Inside Information. Director: Montgomery Tully. Starring Ronald Adam, Basil Hendon and Colette Wilde. A murder hunt is launched after a real body is used as the 'guy' on bonfire night.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Still Waters. Stars Barry Foster, Meg Davies & Ronald Hines. A new sea barrier causes a row between senior Dutch politicians and the radical Green Party.

programme.title: I, The Jury
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Director: Harry Essex. Stars Biff Elliot, Preston Foster & Peggie Castle. Detective Mike Hammer wants to find and kill the person who shot his friend. Clues lead to a beautiful woman.

programme.title: San Ferry Ann
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Director: Jeremy Summers. Stars Wilfred Brambell, David Lodge, Joan Sims & Barbara Windsor. Sound effect comedy about the misadventures of a group of tourists on a trip to France.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Brains. 1971. Stars Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson, Georgina Hale. Budgie's onto something big. It means 'Playing at Home' in Watford for a change and seeing his wife Jean.

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: 2000. Romance. Director: Michael Winterbottom. Stars Peter Mullan, Milla Jovovich & Wes Bentley. A man who sold his wife and daughter to get ahead in business has his past come back to haunt him.

programme.title: There Was a Young Lady
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Michael Denison, Dulcie Gray & Sydney Tafler. A diamond merchants' secretary gets fired by her new boss for being too efficient.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Saddle. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: The Strand
programme.desc: Reginald Foort is at the organ and wants you to sing a long. This song is The Strand.

programme.title: Impact (1963)
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Jack Moir (Conrad Phillips of 'William Tell' fame), a newspaper reporter, is framed by 'The Duke' (George Pastell), a Soho racketeer against whom he has written a series of articles.

programme.title: Prisoners of the Tower
programme.desc: 1946. Documentary. Directed by Cecil H. Williamson. Narrated by Valentine Dyall. A newly discovered film covering the fascinating story of The Tower of London.

programme.title: The Walking Target
programme.desc: 1960. Crime. Directed by Edward L. Cahn. Stars Joan Evans, Ron Foster & Merry Anders. An ex-convict finds romance with the widow of his former accomplice as he attempts to collect his hidden loot.

programme.title: Dick Barton at Bay
programme.desc: 1950. Action. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Don Stannard, Tamara Desni & George Ford. Dick Barton is assigned to find a kidnapped professor and deactivate a death ray before catastrophe occurs.

programme.title: The Ghost Train
programme.desc: 1941. Comedy Horror. Director: Walter Forde. Starring Arthur Askey, Richard Murdoch & Kathleen Harrison. High jinks and chills ensue when a group of people become stranded at an isolated station.

programme.title: The Card
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Director: Ronald Neame. Stars Alec Guinness, Glynis Johns & Valerie Hobson. A man finds ways to rise through the ranks in business and social standing, some honest, some not.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Getaway - Part 1. 1974. Stars John Barron, Jonathan Elsom & John Flanagan. Phil McDowell is on trial for the abduction of Fiona Sumner, a fourteen year old girl. He denies the offense.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Getaway - Part 2. 1974. Stars Lyndon Brook, Elizabeth Weaver & Tina Heath. Fiona Sumner tells the court she initially agreed to go with McDowell but later changed her mind.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Getaway - Part 3. 1974 Stars John Flanagan, John Barron & Lyndon Brook. Son of Philip McDowell tells the court that Fiona wanted to go on the trip to visit her father who she thought was dead.

programme.title: The Stranger Came Home
programme.desc: 1954. Mystery. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Paulette Goddard & William Sylvester. A man returns home after being missing for three years to find those responsible for the attempt on his life.

programme.title: Look At Life Top Chef
programme.desc: 1968. A glimpse into the life of Eugene Kaufeler, one of the top chefs in London.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Chris Robinson's Premonitions/Pete the Poltergeist. 1994. Michael Aspel introduces more stories of the unexplained, including the touching tale of a poltergeist who haunted a couple in Cardiff.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Crisis. 1972. Stars Hilary Tindall, Robin Chadwick & Annette Andre. The strike by the dock workers spells potential disaster and the financial crisis in Hammond Transport becomes more severe.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Root of Evil. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Diana Decker & John Longden. A paper manufacturer finds his safe broken into but does not want to call the police. His wife calls Mark Saber to investigate.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 24. 1975. Gene Pitney performs 'Half Heaven Half Heartache' and 'Blue Angel'. Plus, there's performances from Paul Daniels, Royal Polynesian Revue and Rivendell.

programme.title: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde (1980)
programme.desc: 1980. Horror. Director: Alastair Reid. Stars David Hemmings, Lisa Harrow & Diana Dors. Dr Henry Jekyll experiments on his own personality, resulting in a terrifying struggle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Hand
programme.desc: 1960. Horror. Stars Derek Bond & Bryan Coleman. In WW2, British soldiers are captured by the Japanese and have their hands removed. Years later, someone is removing the hands of people in London.
